{"files": [{"path": "scripts/main.wat", "content": "(module
 (memory (export "memory") 1 1)
 (global $out (mut i32) (i32.const 32775))
 (data (i32.const 32768) "{\22sum\22:")
 (func $emit (param $c i32)
  (i32.store8 (global.get $out) (local.get $c))
  (global.set $out (i32.add (global.get $out) (i32.const 1))))
 (func $number (param $n i32) (local $len i32)
  (if (i32.lt_s (local.get $n) (i32.const 0))
   (then (call $emit (i32.const 45)) (local.set $n (i32.sub (i32.const 0) (local.get $n)))))
  (loop $digits
   (i32.store8 (i32.add (i32.const 60000) (local.get $len))
    (i32.add (i32.rem_u (local.get $n) (i32.const 10)) (i32.const 48)))
   (local.set $len (i32.add (local.get $len) (i32.const 1)))
   (local.set $n (i32.div_u (local.get $n) (i32.const 10)))
   (br_if $digits (local.get $n)))
  (loop $reverse
   (local.set $len (i32.sub (local.get $len) (i32.const 1)))
   (call $emit (i32.load8_u (i32.add (i32.const 60000) (local.get $len))))
   (br_if $reverse (local.get $len))))
 (func (export "run") (param $n i32) (result i32)
  (local $i i32) (local $c i32) (local $v i32) (local $sign i32)
  (local $have i32) (local $sum i32) (local $count i32)
  (local.set $sign (i32.const 1))
  (loop $parse
   (local.set $c (i32.load8_u (local.get $i)))
   (if (i32.and (i32.ge_u (local.get $c) (i32.const 48)) (i32.le_u (local.get $c) (i32.const 57)))
    (then
     (local.set $v (i32.add (i32.mul (local.get $v) (i32.const 10)) (i32.sub (local.get $c) (i32.const 48))))
     (local.set $have (i32.const 1)))
    (else
     (if (i32.eq (local.get $c) (i32.const 45)) (then (local.set $sign (i32.const -1))))
     (if (i32.and (local.get $have) (i32.or (i32.eq (local.get $c) (i32.const 44)) (i32.eq (local.get $c) (i32.const 93))))
      (then
       (local.set $sum (i32.add (local.get $sum) (local.get $v)))
       (local.set $count (i32.add (local.get $count) (i32.const 1)))
       (local.set $v (i32.const 0)) (local.set $have (i32.const 0)) (local.set $sign (i32.const 1))))))
   (local.set $i (i32.add (local.get $i) (i32.const 1)))
   (br_if $parse (i32.lt_u (local.get $i) (local.get $n))))
  (call $number (local.get $sum))
  (call $emit (i32.const 44)) (call $emit (i32.const 34))
  (call $emit (i32.const 99)) (call $emit (i32.const 111)) (call $emit (i32.const 117))
  (call $emit (i32.const 110)) (call $emit (i32.const 116)) (call $emit (i32.const 34)) (call $emit (i32.const 58))
  (call $number (local.get $count)) (call $emit (i32.const 125))
  (i32.sub (global.get $out) (i32.const 32768))))
"}, {"path": "README.md", "content": "# integer-stats

Compute sum and count of signed integers.

Use agentforge run; never execute generated Python on the host.
